is_anopheles.evidence: The paper studies Culex quinquefasciatus, not Anopheles.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports Ace-1 G119S genotyping.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Figure 3c provides genotype counts (GG, GS, SS) for alive and dead mosquitoes.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected in Nagongera, Tororo, Uganda.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study reporting original bioassay and genotyping data.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collection occurred between June and July 2012.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study reports new collections and bioassays.

supplement.evidence: The necessary genotype data is provided in Figure 3c.

assessment.summary: This study investigates insecticide resistance in Culex quinquefasciatus from Tororo, Uganda. It reports bioassay results for six insecticides and genotypes the Ace-1 G119S mutation. It also performs transcriptomic analysis to identify candidate genes for bendiocarb resistance.
